<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description>COMMAND dashboards surface</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_2185255_command_cmd_ceo.do</endpoint><html><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">

<!--
  COMMAND CEO Dashboard. One page: the front page and the navigation together.

  The client's words, 2026-09-13: "for ceo dashboard front page and navigation page
  all in one page with multiple section". Their Control Tower app is a Summary
  page plus a header menu that swaps the whole screen per portfolio; this holds
  all eight portfolios, their cross-portfolio pulse and every portfolio's full
  slot set on one scrolling page, navigated from an orbit of the portfolios.

  What the server does here is deliberately small. It checks the role, builds
  the frame (portfolios, slots, names, units, filters: about 200ms of
  configuration reads) and embeds it, so the whole layout paints on the first
  response. The numbers arrive after, over GlideAjax (CmdCeoAjax), several calls
  in flight at once. A viewer who opened the page in the last three minutes
  already has their numbers remembered, and those are embedded too, so a reload
  paints complete.

  The same three constraints as every other COMMAND page: no inline script (the
  platform stores it as text), no ${} in data (the payload travels base64), and
  every client asset loaded by g:requires under a content-hashed name.
-->

<g:evaluate var="jvar_b64" jelly="true">
  var out;
  try {
    if (!CmdCeoBoard.allowed()) {
      out = { view: 'ceo', denied: true, role: CmdCeoBoard.ROLE,
              viewer: { name: gs.getUserName(), display: gs.getUserDisplayName() } };
    } else {
      var board = new CmdCeoBoard();
      out = board.frame();

      /* Coerced to JavaScript strings before use: RP.getParameterValue returns a
         java.lang.String, whose split and length are Java's. See the dashboard
         page for the incident that taught this. */
      var period = '' + (RP.getParameterValue('period') || '');
      var fraw = '' + (RP.getParameterValue('f') || '');
      var focus = ('' + (RP.getParameterValue('focus') || '')).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '').substring(0, 40);
      out.request = { period: CmdCeoBoard.periodOf(period).key,
                      filters: board.parseFilters(fraw), focus: focus };

      out.groups = board.groups(out);
      var warm = {};
      for (var gi = 0; gi < out.groups.length; gi++) {
        var hit = board.cachedMeasures(out.groups[gi].ids, out.request.period, fraw);
        if (hit) warm[out.groups[gi].name] = hit;
      }
      out.warm = warm;

      var scopeName = '' + gs.getCurrentScopeName();
      out.scope = scopeName.indexOf('x_') === 0 ? scopeName : '';
    }
  } catch (e) {
    out = { view: 'ceo', error: 'The CEO Dashboard could not be built: ' + e };
  }
  var payloadJson = JSON.stringify(out);
  var encoded = (typeof gs.base64Encode === 'function')
      ? gs.base64Encode(payloadJson)
      : GlideStringUtil.base64Encode(payloadJson);
  encoded;
</g:evaluate>

<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   COMMAND. Light-first, because ServiceNow runs light and this has to belong
   inside the platform rather than visit it.

   Tokens are the validated light-theme steps from design/command-brand-kit.html:
   categorical hues re-stepped for a white surface and re-validated there against
   the OKLab lightness band, the chroma floor, adjacent-pair CVD separation and
   the WCAG contrast floor. They are not a tint of the dark theme.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
  --void:#F3F5F8; --ground:#F7F9FB; --surface:#FFFFFF;
  --surface-2:#F8FAFC; --surface-3:#EDF0F5;
  --edge:rgba(16,22,32,.10); --edge-2:rgba(16,22,32,.17); --edge-lit:rgba(16,22,32,.28);
  --ink-1:#10161F; --ink-2:#475364; --ink-3:#6B778A; --ink-4:#99A3B3;
  --grid:rgba(16,22,32,.07); --baseline:rgba(16,22,32,.18);

  /* categorical, fixed order, never cycled */
  --c1:#008C9E; --c2:#A5741F; --c3:#6355C8;
  --c4:#C24438; --c5:#1B8A67; --c6:#9A4B90; --c-other:#7A8394;

  /* sequential runs light to dark on a white ground */
  --q1:#E2F2F5; --q2:#C2E4EA; --q3:#93CFDA;
  --q4:#55B0C0; --q5:#008C9E; --q6:#006B7A; --q7:#00505C;

  --ok:#167C4F; --warn:#8A6410; --crit:#C0272E;
  --ok-wash:rgba(22,124,79,.10); --warn-wash:rgba(138,100,16,.11);
  --crit-wash:rgba(192,39,46,.10);

  /* The empty step. A heatmap cell with no records is not the lightest step of
     the ramp -- that would read as "a few" -- it is off the ramp entirely. */
  --q0:#F0F3F7;

  /* Diverging pair, for the one encoding in this product that carries polarity
     rather than identity: a waterfall step and a variance column. Deliberately
     NOT the status tokens. Status means good/bad, which is a judgement nobody on
     this engagement has defined for a change in volume -- more incidents may be
     better reporting -- so these say up and down and nothing more. */
  --up:#2C6FB5; --down:#B5562C;

  --fill-area:.30;

  --display:"Space Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --sans:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}

/* The platform wraps UI Pages in its own chrome, so everything is scoped under
   the mount rather than applied to body. Nothing here can leak into the nav. */
#cmd-wrap, #cmd-wrap *, #cmd-wrap *::before, #cmd-wrap *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#cmd-wrap{
  background:var(--void); color:var(--ink-1);
  font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14px; line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  padding:28px 28px 64px; min-height:100vh;
}
#cmd-wrap a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none}

.d2{font-family:var(--display); font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px); line-height:1.08;
  letter-spacing:-.03em; font-weight:600; margin:6px 0 0}
.h3{font-family:var(--display); font-size:15px; line-height:1.3;
  letter-spacing:-.012em; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px}
.sm{font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.56; color:var(--ink-2); margin:0 0 12px}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}

/* ── header ── */
.app-h{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between;
  gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:22px}
.app-h-r{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.crumb{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.13em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); display:flex; gap:8px;
  align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap}
.crumb a{color:var(--ink-3); border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.crumb a:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-bottom-color:var(--edge-2)}
.crumb .sep{color:var(--ink-4)}
.crumb .now{color:var(--ink-1); font-weight:600}
.sub{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:7px;
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}
.sub .dot{color:var(--ink-4)}

.btn{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; padding:7px 13px; border-radius:7px;
  border:1px solid var(--edge-2); cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink-1);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFFFF,#F5F7FA);
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; white-space:nowrap;
  transition:border-color .18s var(--ease-out), background .18s var(--ease-out)}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--edge-lit); background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFFFF,#EDF1F6)}

.chip{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:9.5px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:5px 9px; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid var(--edge);
  color:var(--ink-2); background:rgba(16,22,32,.03); white-space:nowrap}
.chip.sm{font-size:9px; padding:3px 7px}
.chip .dot{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; flex:none}
.chip.ok{color:var(--ok); border-color:rgba(22,124,79,.3); background:var(--ok-wash)}
.chip.warn{color:var(--warn); border-color:rgba(138,100,16,.3); background:var(--warn-wash)}
.chip.crit{color:var(--crit); border-color:rgba(192,39,46,.3); background:var(--crit-wash)}

/* ── panel: the core material ── */
.panel{position:relative; border-radius:13px; min-width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFFFF,#FCFDFE);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,22,32,.05),
             0 12px 28px -18px rgba(16,22,32,.22)}
.panel::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit;
  padding:1px; pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,22,32,.13), rgba(16,22,32,.06));
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite:xor; mask-composite:exclude}
.panel > *{position:relative}
.pad{padding:20px}

.grid-panels{display:grid; gap:14px; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.grid-panels .span2{grid-column:span 2}

/* ── skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   The client's own words: "report design outcome skeleton". There is nothing
   this can swap into once real content arrives -- the payload is embedded in
   the initial HTML server-side (see cmd_dashboard.xhtml's g:evaluate), so by
   the time this page's own JS runs, the data is already sitting in the DOM.
   The entire wait a viewer feels is server build time that happens before the
   browser receives a single byte of the response -- measured elsewhere in this
   engagement at 2 to 7+ seconds depending on table and persona -- and no
   partial response or safe client fetch exists to paint into during it (an
   XHR from a logged-in session on this instance was measured never to
   return). So this paints on the PAGE BEING LEFT, the instant a link to
   another COMMAND page is clicked, shaped like the page that is coming --
   header, KPI row, chart grid for a dashboard; header and a card grid for the
   catalog -- then hands off to the browser's own navigation. No network call,
   no swap-in, nothing that could hang: it is a still frame painted from
   knowledge already on the page, held for exactly as long as the real
   response takes, then replaced by it. */
.skel-block{border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface-3);
  position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.skel-block::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--edge-lit), transparent);
  animation:skel-sweep 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes skel-sweep{
  from{transform:translateX(-100%)} to{transform:translateX(100%)}
}
.skel-h1{height:13px; width:120px; margin-bottom:14px}
.skel-h2{height:30px; width:60%; max-width:340px; margin-bottom:6px}
.skel-h3{height:13px; width:40%; max-width:220px}
.skel-kpis{display:flex; gap:14px; margin:24px 0}
.skel-kpi{flex:1; height:96px}
.skel-panel{height:280px}
.skel-title{height:14px; width:45%; margin-bottom:8px}
.skel-sub{height:10px; width:70%}
.skel-panel-h{padding:15px}
.skel-cards{display:grid; gap:14px; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.skel-card{height:150px}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .skel-kpis{flex-direction:column}
  .grid-panels, .skel-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

.cp{display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:18px 18px 15px}
.cp-h{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px}
.cp-t{font-family:var(--display); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.014em}
.cp-s{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:4px; line-height:1.45}
.cp-m{display:flex; gap:6px; flex:none; padding-top:2px}
.form-tag{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); border:1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius:4px; padding:3px 6px; white-space:nowrap}
.cp-b{margin-top:16px; flex:1; min-height:0}
.cp.focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--c1) inset}
.cp-focus-tag{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--c1); margin-top:6px}
.cp-f{margin-top:14px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge);
  display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center}
.drill-link{font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:var(--c1);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.drill-link:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--c1)}
.drill-link.muted{color:var(--ink-3)}
.drill-link.muted:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-bottom-color:var(--edge-2)}

.cavs{margin-top:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px}
.cav{font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink-2);
  border-left:0; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface-3)}
.cav.warn{color:var(--warn); background:var(--warn-wash)}

.note{font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink-2);
  border:1px solid var(--edge); border-radius:9px; padding:14px 16px;
  background:var(--surface); margin-top:14px}

/* ── charts ── */
svg.ch{display:block; width:100%; height:auto; overflow:visible}
svg.ch .gl{stroke:var(--grid); stroke-width:1}
svg.ch .bl{stroke:var(--baseline); stroke-width:1}
svg.ch .tk{fill:var(--ink-3); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.05em}
svg.ch .ct{fill:var(--ink-2); font-family:var(--sans); font-size:11.5px}
svg.ch .ctOn{fill:#FFFFFF; font-family:var(--sans); font-size:11.5px}
svg.ch .vl{fill:var(--ink-1); font-family:var(--display); font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
svg.ch .vlOn{fill:#FFFFFF; font-family:var(--display); font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
svg.ch .big{fill:var(--ink-1); font-family:var(--display); font-size:30px;
  font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.035em; font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
svg.ch .huge{fill:var(--ink-1); font-family:var(--display); font-size:46px;
  font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.04em; font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}

/* ── tables ── */
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.tbl{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}
.tbl th{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); text-align:right;
  padding:0 12px 9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge-2); white-space:nowrap}
.tbl th.l{text-align:left}
.tbl td{padding:9px 12px 9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);
  text-align:right; color:var(--ink-2); white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td.l{text-align:left; color:var(--ink-1)}
.tbl tr:hover td{background:rgba(16,22,32,.02)}
.tbl .vr{color:var(--ink-3); margin-left:9px; font-size:11.5px; white-space:normal}

/* ── drill panel ── */
.drill-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; border-radius:9px;
  overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--edge); background:var(--edge)}
.drill-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--surface);
  transition:background .18s var(--ease-out)}
.drill-row:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.drill-row.off{background:var(--surface-3); cursor:default}
.drill-row.off:hover{background:var(--surface-3)}
.drill-l{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0}
.drill-n{font-family:var(--display); font-size:13px; font-weight:600}
.drill-r{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}
.drill-row.off .drill-n{color:var(--ink-3)}
.drill-meta{flex:none}

/* ── catalog ── */
.area-h{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; margin:26px 0 12px}
.area-n{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.02em}
.area-c{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.13em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3)}
.cards{display:grid; gap:12px; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(262px,1fr))}
.card{border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; display:flex;
  flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--edge);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFFFF,#FBFCFE);
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,22,32,.04);
  transition:transform .26s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .26s var(--ease-out),
             border-color .26s var(--ease-out)}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:var(--edge-lit);
  box-shadow:0 14px 32px -18px rgba(16,22,32,.3)}
.card-b{padding:15px 16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; flex:1}
.card-n{font-family:var(--display); font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.014em; line-height:1.3}
.card-d{font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-3); line-height:1.45}
.card-f{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:9px;
  margin-top:auto; padding-top:8px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-4)}


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Dark. A selected counterpart, not an inversion.
   Its own steps from the same hues, validated against its own #0D1117 surface.
   Three things genuinely flip and are therefore defined twice rather than
   computed: the sequential ramp direction, because on dark brightness is
   magnitude and on light darkness is; the emphasis step per hue, which goes
   lighter on dark and darker on light; and text sitting on a high sequential
   step. Getting the first of those backwards is the commonest dark-mode
   heatmap bug.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --void:#06080B; --ground:#0A0D12; --surface:#0D1117;
  --surface-2:#121924; --surface-3:#18202D;
  --edge:rgba(255,255,255,.08); --edge-2:rgba(255,255,255,.14); --edge-lit:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  --ink-1:#E8EDF5; --ink-2:#98A5BA; --ink-3:#606E86; --ink-4:#3B4657;
  --grid:rgba(255,255,255,.06); --baseline:rgba(255,255,255,.13);

  --c1:#16A5BA; --c2:#B8842A; --c3:#7A6DE0;
  --c4:#D8544A; --c5:#2AA47E; --c6:#B25FA8; --c-other:#5A6472;

  /* sequential runs dark to bright here, the inverse of the light theme */
  --q1:#0E252C; --q2:#103A46; --q3:#125264;
  --q4:#146D82; --q5:#16A5BA; --q6:#2AC8DC; --q7:#5EE4F2;

  --ok:#2FBF7F; --warn:#D9A62E; --crit:#FF4C5B;
  --ok-wash:rgba(47,191,127,.13); --warn-wash:rgba(217,166,46,.13);
  --crit-wash:rgba(255,76,91,.13);

  --q0:#0F151E;
  --up:#5A9BE0; --down:#E0895A;

  --fill-area:.38;
}
/* Panels invert their material: on dark the top highlight does the work that the
   hairline and shadow do on light. */
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .panel{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#141C27 0%, #0C1118 58%, #0A0E14 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.065), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.55),
             0 16px 40px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .panel::before{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.18), rgba(255,255,255,.03))}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .btn{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.055), rgba(255,255,255,.012))}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .btn:hover{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.09), rgba(255,255,255,.025))}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .chip{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .card{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#131B26 0%, #0A0E14 100%);
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .card:hover{box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(0,0,0,1)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .cav{background:var(--surface-3)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .drill-row{background:var(--surface)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .drill-row:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .drill-row.off{background:var(--surface-3)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .note{background:var(--surface)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .field{background:rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .tbl tr:hover td{background:rgba(255,255,255,.022)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] svg.ch .ctOn,
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] svg.ch .vlOn{fill:#04161A}

/* ── theme toggle ── */
.seg{display:inline-flex; border:1px solid var(--edge); border-radius:8px; padding:2px;
  background:var(--surface-3); gap:2px}
.seg button{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.09em; padding:5px 10px;
  border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-3); cursor:pointer;
  text-transform:uppercase}
.seg button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--ink-1); background:var(--surface);
  font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,22,32,.12)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .seg button[aria-selected="true"]{
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07)}

/* ── catalog controls ── */
.cat-bar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:20px 0 6px}
.pager{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px;
  flex-wrap:wrap; margin:14px 0; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--edge);
  border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface-2)}
.pager .btn.ghost{opacity:.4; pointer-events:none}
.field{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--edge-2);
  border-radius:8px; padding:7px 11px; background:var(--surface); min-width:230px}
.field input{border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-1);
  font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13px; width:100%}
.field input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-4)}
.filters{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.fchip{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:6px 10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--edge); cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--ink-2); background:var(--surface); white-space:nowrap;
  transition:border-color .16s var(--ease-out), color .16s var(--ease-out)}
.fchip:hover{border-color:var(--edge-lit); color:var(--ink-1)}
.fchip[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-lit);
  background:var(--surface-3); font-weight:600}
.cat-count{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-left:auto; white-space:nowrap}

/* ── card, restyled: scannable, with a real distribution preview ── */
.card-h{padding:15px 16px 0}
.card-n{font-family:var(--display); font-size:15.5px; font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.016em; line-height:1.25}
.card-sub{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-4); margin-top:4px}
.card-stats{display:flex; gap:16px; padding:12px 16px 0; flex-wrap:wrap}
.cs{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px}
.cs-v{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em;
  line-height:1.1; font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
.cs-l{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-4)}
.card-prev{padding:13px 16px 0}
.card-prev-l{font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-bottom:6px}
.prev-bar{display:flex; height:7px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; gap:2px;
  background:var(--surface-3)}
.prev-bar i{display:block; height:100%; border-radius:2px}
.prev-keys{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.pk{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-2)}
.pk i{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:2px; flex:none}
.card-f{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:9px;
  margin-top:auto; padding:13px 16px 14px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-4)}
.card-go{color:var(--c1); font-weight:600}
.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr))}
.empty{padding:26px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-3); font-size:13px}

/* ── responsive: the panel grid collapses, and wide charts keep their scale ── */
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .grid-panels{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .grid-panels .span2{grid-column:span 1}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #cmd-wrap{padding:16px 14px 44px}
  .cp{padding:14px}
  .pad{padding:15px}
  .cp-b{overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; scrollbar-width:thin}
  /* A 520-unit viewBox squeezed into 300px renders its 9.5px axis labels at 5px,
     so the chart keeps a floor width and the panel body scrolls instead. */
  .cp-b svg.ch{min-width:430px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  #cmd-wrap *{transition:none !important; animation:none !important}
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   The analysis layer

   KPI tiles, the report matrix, hover reports, cross-highlighting and the
   filter bar. Everything here is scoped under #cmd-wrap like the rest, with the
   single exception of the tooltip, which is documented at its rule.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── KPI row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap .kpi-row{
  display:grid; gap:12px; margin:0 0 16px;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(230px,100%), 1fr))}
#cmd-wrap .kpi{
  background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--edge); border-radius:12px;
  padding:14px 16px 13px; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-l{
  font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); margin-bottom:7px}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-v{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-n{
  font-family:var(--display); font-size:31px; line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:-.02em; color:var(--ink-1); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-d{
  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:20px;
  background:var(--surface-3); color:var(--ink-2);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* Direction is carried by an arrow glyph as well as by hue, so the tile is
   readable without colour and in forced-colors mode. */
#cmd-wrap .kpi-d.up{color:var(--up); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--up) 12%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-d.down{color:var(--down); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--down) 12%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-s{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:7px; line-height:1.45}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-c{
  position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px; font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.05em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--warn); background:var(--warn-wash);
  padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px}

/* ── the analytics caption under a trend ─────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap .cp-an{
  display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:baseline; flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin:10px 0 0; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge);
  font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); line-height:1.5}
#cmd-wrap .an-k{
  font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ink-2); background:var(--surface-3); padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px}

/* ── the report matrix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap table.mx{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#cmd-wrap table.mx tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
#cmd-wrap table.mx tfoot td{
  border-top:1.5px solid var(--edge-2); font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-1)}
#cmd-wrap .mx-bar{
  height:7px; min-width:56px; background:var(--surface-3); border-radius:4px;
  overflow:hidden}
#cmd-wrap .mx-bar > i{display:block; height:100%; background:var(--c1); border-radius:4px}
#cmd-wrap .spark{width:92px; height:22px; display:block; overflow:visible}
#cmd-wrap td.up{color:var(--up)}
#cmd-wrap td.down{color:var(--down)}

/* ── hover report ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* The one rule not scoped to the mount. The element is appended to the document
   body on purpose: a tooltip inside the panel is clipped by the panel's own
   overflow, and inside the mobile horizontal-scroll container it scrolls away
   from the mark it belongs to.

   Note for anyone editing this file: an angle bracket in a CSS comment is an open
   tag to the XML parser, because this stylesheet is inlined into a Jelly page.
   Writing the element name in brackets here cost one deploy. */
.cmd-tip{
  position:absolute; z-index:9999; pointer-events:none; opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(3px); transition:opacity .12s var(--ease-out),
  transform .12s var(--ease-out);
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-1);
  border:1px solid var(--edge-2); border-radius:9px; padding:9px 11px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(16,22,32,.09), 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(16,22,32,.35);
  font-family:var(--sans); font-size:12px; line-height:1.55; max-width:290px}
.cmd-tip.on{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
.cmd-tip .tip-h{
  font-weight:650; color:var(--ink-1); margin-bottom:3px;
  font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:-.005em}
.cmd-tip .tip-r{color:var(--ink-2); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] .cmd-tip{
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}

/* ── cross-highlighting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap .hit{cursor:pointer}
#cmd-wrap .hit:focus{outline:2px solid var(--c1); outline-offset:2px}
/* Recede rather than disappear: a dimmed mark still holds its position, so the
   shape of the whole distribution stays readable behind the selection. */
#cmd-wrap .dim{opacity:.17; transition:opacity .15s var(--ease-out)}
#cmd-wrap .lit{opacity:1}
#cmd-wrap tr.lit{background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap tr.dim{opacity:.35}

#cmd-wrap .sel-bar{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin:0 0 14px; padding:10px 13px; border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap .sel-l{font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-1); font-size:13px}
#cmd-wrap .sel-n{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); flex:1 1 220px}

/* ── filter bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap .filter-bar{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0 0 15px}
#cmd-wrap .fb-l{
  font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap .fb-chip{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:4px 5px 4px 10px;
  border-radius:20px; background:var(--surface-3); border:1px solid var(--edge);
  font-size:12px}
#cmd-wrap .fb-f{color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap .fb-v{color:var(--ink-1); font-weight:600}
#cmd-wrap .fb-x{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  width:17px; height:17px; border-radius:50%; text-decoration:none;
  color:var(--ink-3); background:var(--surface); font-size:13px; line-height:1}
#cmd-wrap .fb-x:hover{color:var(--crit); background:var(--crit-wash)}
#cmd-wrap .fb-clear{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); text-decoration:none}
#cmd-wrap .fb-clear:hover{color:var(--ink-1); text-decoration:underline}

/* ── workspace context strip ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   The list this analysis was opened from, in the list's own terms. Same chip
   grammar as the filter bar below it, with a series-one rule on the left so it
   reads as provenance rather than as another filter to remove. */
#cmd-wrap .ws-strip{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:-6px 0 16px;
  padding:9px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--edge); border-left:3px solid var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap .ws-l{
  font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); margin-right:4px}
#cmd-wrap .ws-c{
  padding:3px 10px; border-radius:20px; background:var(--surface-3);
  border:1px solid var(--edge); font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-1)}
#cmd-wrap .ws-j{font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-3); text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.08em}
#cmd-wrap .ws-g{
  padding:3px 10px; border-radius:20px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
  color:var(--c1); border:1px solid var(--c1); background:transparent}

#cmd-wrap .ws-by{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-left:auto}
#cmd-wrap .ws-by-l{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap .ws-by-s{font:inherit; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-1);
  background:var(--surface-3); border:1px solid var(--edge-2); border-radius:8px;
  padding:5px 28px 5px 10px; min-width:200px; cursor:pointer}
#cmd-wrap .ws-by-s:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c1); outline-offset:2px}
#cmd-wrap .ws-rec{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:-8px 0 16px;
  padding:9px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--edge); border-left:3px solid var(--c2)}
#cmd-wrap .ws-rec-id{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;
  color:var(--c2); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px}
#cmd-wrap .ws-f{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:3px 10px;
  border-radius:20px; background:var(--surface-3); border:1px solid var(--edge);
  font-size:12px; text-decoration:none}
#cmd-wrap .ws-f:hover{border-color:var(--c2)}

/* Inside the workspace modal: the modal already frames the page, so the page's
   own outer padding and full-viewport height would only waste its space. */
.cmd-embed #cmd-wrap{padding:18px 20px 36px; min-height:0}
.cmd-embed #cmd-wrap .app-h{margin-bottom:16px}

/* ── small controls ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#cmd-wrap .seg.sm button{font-size:11px; padding:3px 9px}
#cmd-wrap .btn.sm{font-size:11.5px; padding:4px 11px}
#cmd-wrap .btn.ghost{background:transparent; border-color:var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap .cp-m{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ── motion ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .cmd-tip, #cmd-wrap .dim{transition:none}
}

/* The window slicer sits in the segmented control, but its items are links
   rather than buttons because each one is a different page. */
#cmd-wrap .seg a{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:3px 9px; font-size:11px;
  color:var(--ink-2); text-decoration:none; border-radius:6px;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#cmd-wrap .seg a[aria-selected="true"]{
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-1); font-weight:600;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,22,32,.10)}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] #cmd-wrap .seg a[aria-selected="true"]{
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

/* ── converted report provenance ───────────────────────────────────────────
   Sits between the filter bar and the numbers, because it qualifies every
   number below it. Deliberately quiet: it is evidence, not a banner. */
.prov{margin:0 0 18px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;
      align-items:flex-start}
.prov-h{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.prov-rows{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; width:100%}
.prov-row{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.prov-row .sm{color:var(--ink-2); line-height:1.55; flex:1 1 340px; min-width:0}
.prov-forms{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex:0 0 auto}
.prov-forms code{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.04em;
                 padding:3px 7px; border:1px solid var(--edge-2); border-radius:5px;
                 color:var(--ink-3); background:var(--surf-2)}
.prov-forms code.now{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-1)}
.prov-forms .sep{color:var(--ink-4)}

/* ── catalog tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Two entry points, one surface. Underline rather than a pill because the tab
   row sits directly under a display heading and a second filled shape there
   competes with it. */
.tabs{display:flex; gap:2px; margin:0 0 22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge-2)}
.tab{padding:9px 14px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-3);
     border-bottom:2px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-1px}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink-1)}
.tab.now{color:var(--ink-1); font-weight:600; border-bottom-color:var(--accent)}

/* ── saved report list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   A list, not cards. Cards are for subjects, where a preview chart earns the
   area; a report is a name and a destination, and several hundred of them read
   far faster as dense rows grouped by what they are about. */
.rep-groups{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:26px}
.rep-group-h{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; margin-bottom:9px;
             padding-bottom:7px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge-2)}
.rep-list{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));
          gap:1px; background:var(--edge-2); border:1px solid var(--edge-2);
          border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden}
.rep{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; padding:12px 14px;
     background:var(--surf-1); min-width:0}
.rep:hover{background:var(--surf-2)}
.rep-t{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-1); line-height:1.4;
       overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.rep-m{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap;
       font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-3)}
.rep-m code{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.05em;
            color:var(--ink-3)}
.rep-dyn{padding:1px 6px; border:1px solid var(--edge-2); border-radius:999px;
         font-size:10px; color:var(--ink-3)}

/* ── print ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   The browser's print pipeline is also its "save as PDF", so this is the whole
   PDF export. Forced to the light palette regardless of the on-screen theme:
   a dark dashboard printed as-is is a page of ink, and nobody wants the version
   of this file that arrives in an inbox to be the one that empties a cartridge. */
@media print {
  :root, :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --surf-0:#fff; --surf-1:#fff; --surf-2:#fff;
    --ink-1:#111; --ink-2:#333; --ink-3:#555; --ink-4:#777;
    --edge-1:#bbb; --edge-2:#ddd;
  }
  body{background:#fff}
  .seg, .tabs, .cat-bar, .btn, .fchip, .win, .tip{display:none !important}
  .app-h{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd; padding-bottom:12px}
  /* Panels must not be split across a page break: half a chart on each side of
     a fold is worse than a shorter page. */
  .panel{break-inside:avoid; page-break-inside:avoid; border:1px solid #ddd;
         box-shadow:none}
  .grid-panels{display:block}
  .grid-panels > *{margin:0 0 14px}
  a{text-decoration:none; color:inherit}
  /* The ACL verdict has to survive printing. A number on paper without the
     statement of what it was checked against is the one thing this product
     exists to prevent. */
  .chip{border:1px solid #999 !important; color:#111 !important}
  .prov{border:1px solid #999}
}

/* ── chart form control ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Sits where the form tag used to, because it says the same thing and now
   answers back. Closed it is a label; open it is the argument for the drawing
   plus the alternatives the shape supports and the ones it does not. */
.formsel{position:relative}
.formsel-t{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.11em;
           text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); background:none;
           border:1px solid var(--edge-2); border-radius:5px; padding:4px 9px;
           cursor:pointer}
.formsel-t:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-1)}
.formsel.open .formsel-t{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-1)}
.formsel-m{display:none; position:absolute; right:0; top:calc(100% + 6px);
           z-index:40; width:320px; max-width:78vw; padding:12px;
           background:var(--surf-1); border:1px solid var(--edge-1);
           border-radius:9px; box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
           max-height:60vh; overflow-y:auto}
.formsel.open .formsel-m{display:block}
.formsel-h{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; padding-bottom:10px;
           margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge-2)}
.formsel-h .sm{line-height:1.5}
.formsel-o{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; padding:8px 9px;
           border-radius:6px; margin:0 -3px}
.formsel-o:hover{background:var(--surf-2)}
.formsel-n{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-1)}
.formsel-o .sm, .formsel-x .sm{line-height:1.45; color:var(--ink-3)}
.formsel-r{margin-top:9px; padding-top:9px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge-2);
           display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px}
/* Refusals are shown, not hidden, and are deliberately not clickable: the point
   is the reason, not a disabled control inviting a second attempt. */
.formsel-x{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; opacity:.72}
.formsel-x .formsel-n{color:var(--ink-3); text-decoration:line-through}

/* The empty-slice notice: a drill that landed on nothing. Sized like a panel so
   it sits where the panels would have been, rather than reading as an error
   banner attached to the page. */
.empty-slice { max-width: 640px; }
.empty-slice .h3 { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.empty-acts { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* A KPI card's own history. Sized to sit under the number without competing with
   it: the value is the statement, the line is the context. */
.kpi-spark { margin-top: 6px; opacity: 0.85; }
.kpi-spark .spark { width: 100%; height: 22px; display: block; }
/* A measure that could not be computed. Muted rather than alarming: on the source
   dashboard the same card shows a confident 0. */
.kpi-n.none { color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 500; }

/* The record link on a KPI card. Quiet until pointed at: the number is the
   statement, this is the way to check it. */
.kpi-open{
  display:inline-block; margin-top:10px;
  font-family:var(--mono,ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent; transition:color .12s, border-color .12s;
}
.kpi-open:hover, .kpi-open:focus{ color:var(--c1); border-bottom-color:var(--c1); }
.kpi{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }

/* One measure of a portfolio, opened as a subject. States what this page is a
   view of and how to leave it, because an analysis you arrived at from a card is
   otherwise indistinguishable from an unexplained filter. */
.measure-bar{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:10px 14px; margin:0 0 18px;
  background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--edge);
  border-left:2.5px solid var(--c1); border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;
}
.measure-l{ font-family:var(--display,inherit); font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-1); }
.measure-n{ color:var(--ink-3); font-size:12.5px; }

/* The gauge tile. The arc is centred in the space a tile has left after its
   label and above its sub-line, and is capped in width so that a wide tile grows
   the whitespace around it rather than blowing the arc up to a different scale
   from every other mark on the page. */
#cmd-wrap .kpi-gauge{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  margin:2px 0 4px; flex:1 1 auto}
#cmd-wrap .kpi-gauge .ch.gauge{width:100%; max-width:210px; height:auto; display:block}
/* The value inside the arc. Sized in the gauge's own viewBox units so it clears
   the arc's inner radius, rather than inheriting the 46px meant for a viewBox
   two and a half times wider. */
svg.ch.gauge .gval{fill:var(--ink-1); font-family:var(--display); font-size:27px;
  font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.04em; font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CEO Dashboard. Inlined into cmd_ceo only, on top of cmd.css.

   Designed dark-first, because the page it answers is: the client's references
   draw the portfolios as lit spheres on a deep ground, and this is the page most
   likely to go on a wall. The light theme is a real theme, not an afterthought --
   every colour here is a token that both themes define.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#cmd-wrap.ceo{
  --glow-1:#16A5BA; --glow-2:#7A6DE0;
  --orb-1:#FFFFFF; --orb-2:#F2F6F9; --orb-3:#D6E1E9; --orb-4:#AFC1CD;
  --orb-ink:#0B1620; --orb-ink-2:#4A5A6A;
  --orb-halo:rgba(0,140,158,.22);
  --bar-bg:rgba(247,249,251,.78);
  --ring:rgba(0,140,158,.28); --ring-faint:rgba(16,22,32,.08);
  --spoke:rgba(16,22,32,.08); --spoke-on:rgba(0,140,158,.55);
  --good:var(--ok); --bad:var(--crit);
  padding:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1100px 620px at 72% -8%, rgba(0,140,158,.10), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(900px 560px at 6% 12%, rgba(99,85,200,.07), transparent 60%),
    var(--void);
}
:root[data-cmd-theme="dark"] #cmd-wrap.ceo, :root:not([data-cmd-theme]) #cmd-wrap.ceo{
  --orb-halo:rgba(22,165,186,.34);
  --bar-bg:rgba(8,11,16,.72);
  --ring:rgba(22,165,186,.34); --ring-faint:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  --spoke:rgba(255,255,255,.07); --spoke-on:rgba(61,224,245,.7);
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 72% -10%, rgba(22,165,186,.18), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 600px at 4% 18%, rgba(122,109,224,.12), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 500px at 50% 100%, rgba(22,165,186,.06), transparent 70%),
    #05070B;
  color:var(--ink-1);
}

#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-page{max-width:1560px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px 56px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ic{width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8;
  stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; flex:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ic.big{width:34px; height:34px; color:var(--c1); margin-bottom:14px}

/* ── top bar ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-bar{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:30; display:flex; align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:12px 0;
  margin:0 -28px 0; padding-left:28px; padding-right:28px;
  background:var(--bar-bg); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.3); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-l, #cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-r{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-l{gap:26px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand .mark{width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:9px; display:grid; place-items:center;
  color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(140deg, var(--c1), var(--glow-2));
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px -6px var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand .mark .ic{width:15px; height:15px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand-t{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand-t .b1{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.2em; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .brand-t .b2{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:-.01em}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav{display:flex; gap:2px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav .nl{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-3); padding:6px 11px; border-radius:7px;
  transition:color .15s, background .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav .nl:hover{color:var(--ink-1); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav .nl[aria-current="true"]{color:var(--ink-1); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .seg.period button{font-size:10.5px; padding:6px 11px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn{width:33px; height:33px; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid var(--edge-2); background:transparent; color:var(--ink-2); cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .15s, color .15s, background .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-lit); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn.sm{width:26px; height:26px; border-color:transparent}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn.sm .ic{width:14px; height:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn.spin .ic{animation:ceo-spin 1s linear infinite}
@keyframes ceo-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .asof{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--ink-3);
  min-width:92px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fbtn{position:relative}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fbtn.on{border-color:var(--c1); color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fbtn .cnt:empty{display:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fbtn .cnt{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; min-width:17px; height:17px; border-radius:9px;
  display:inline-grid; place-items:center; background:var(--c1); color:#fff; padding:0 5px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .menu{position:relative}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .menu-m{display:none; position:absolute; right:0; top:calc(100% + 6px); z-index:40;
  min-width:190px; padding:6px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--edge-2); box-shadow:0 18px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .menu.open .menu-m{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .menu-m button{text-align:left; font-size:13px; padding:9px 11px; border:0; border-radius:7px;
  background:transparent; color:var(--ink-1); cursor:pointer}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .menu-m button:hover{background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .btn.primary{background:var(--c1); border-color:var(--c1); color:#fff}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08); background:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .btn.ghost{background:transparent}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .btn.sm{font-size:11.5px; padding:5px 10px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .btn .ic{width:14px; height:14px}

/* ── filter chips and status ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchips{display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:12px 0 0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchips.on{display:flex}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchips .fl{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchip{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; padding:4px 5px 4px 11px;
  border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--c1); color:var(--ink-1);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c1) 12%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchip .x{border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-2); cursor:pointer; padding:2px;
  display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchip .x:hover{color:var(--ink-1); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fchip .x .ic{width:12px; height:12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .fapp{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-status .note{margin:12px 0 0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ── sections ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .sec{padding:54px 0 8px; scroll-margin-top:70px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .sec-h{max-width:880px; margin-bottom:22px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .sec-t{font-family:var(--display); font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px); font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.12; margin:8px 0 0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .sec-l{color:var(--ink-2); font-size:14px; margin:9px 0 0; max-width:720px}

/* ── hero ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .sec.hero{padding-top:30px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-g{display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,.8fr) minmax(0,2fr); gap:34px; align-items:center}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-t{font-family:var(--display); font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,54px); font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-.04em; line-height:1; margin:12px 0 0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-lead{color:var(--ink-2); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.6; margin:14px 0 0; max-width:440px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-stats{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:18px 26px; margin:22px 0 22px; align-items:center}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hs{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hs-v{font-family:var(--display); font-size:26px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; line-height:1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hs-l{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:6px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .hs.chipw{justify-content:center}

#cmd-wrap.ceo .moves{padding:18px 18px 12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .moves-h{margin-bottom:12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .moves-s{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:2px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tally{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ti{border-radius:9px; padding:9px 10px; background:var(--surface-3); display:flex; flex-direction:column}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ti-n{font-family:var(--display); font-size:22px; font-weight:600; line-height:1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ti-l{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:4px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ti.bad .ti-n{color:var(--bad)} #cmd-wrap.ceo .ti.good .ti-n{color:var(--good)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; text-align:left;
  padding:10px 4px; border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--edge); background:transparent;
  color:var(--ink-1); cursor:pointer; border-radius:0; width:100%}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv:hover{background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-t{display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-n{font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.35}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-w{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:2px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-v{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-now{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .mv-skel{height:34px; margin-top:8px}

/* ── delta chip ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px;
  font-weight:600; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; line-height:1.5}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl .a{font-size:8px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl.good{color:var(--good); background:var(--ok-wash)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl.bad{color:var(--bad); background:var(--crit-wash)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl.flat, #cmd-wrap.ceo .dl.neutral{color:var(--ink-2); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dl.none{display:none}

/* ── value ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .val{display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:2px; font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .val .u{font-size:.55em; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-3); margin-left:1px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .val .u.sp{margin-left:.28em}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .val .n.none{color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .skel-line{display:inline-block; width:64px; height:.8em; border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--surface-3); position:relative; overflow:hidden; vertical-align:middle}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .skel-line.sm{width:44px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .skel-line::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--edge-lit), transparent);
  animation:skel-sweep 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}

/* ── the orbit ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit{position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:1000/720; container-type:inline-size;
  isolation:isolate}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit-bg{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:visible}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring{fill:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring.main{stroke:var(--ring); stroke-width:1.4}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring.faint{stroke:var(--ring-faint); stroke-width:1; stroke-dasharray:2 7}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring.flow{stroke:url(#ceoRing); stroke-width:2.6; stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-dasharray:3 38; opacity:.85; animation:ceo-flow 18s linear infinite}
@keyframes ceo-flow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-820}}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .spoke{stroke:var(--spoke); stroke-width:1.2; transition:stroke .25s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .spoke.on{stroke:var(--spoke-on); stroke-width:1.6}

#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb{position:absolute; aspect-ratio:1; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius:50%;
  border:0; padding:0; cursor:pointer; color:var(--orb-ink);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 28%, var(--orb-1) 0%, var(--orb-2) 34%, var(--orb-3) 70%, var(--orb-4) 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 0 2.4cqw .5cqw var(--orb-halo),
             0 1.4cqw 3cqw -1cqw rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 -.8cqw 1.6cqw rgba(0,40,60,.16);
  transition:transform .3s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .3s var(--ease-out);
  display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center; font-family:var(--sans)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:-.6cqw; border-radius:50%;
  border:.18cqw solid var(--ring); transition:border-color .3s, inset .3s; pointer-events:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sat{animation:ceo-breathe 6s ease-in-out infinite}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sat:nth-of-type(2n){animation-delay:-3s}
@keyframes ceo-breathe{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 0 2.2cqw .4cqw var(--orb-halo),
                     0 1.4cqw 3cqw -1cqw rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 -.8cqw 1.6cqw rgba(0,40,60,.16)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 0 3.4cqw .9cqw var(--orb-halo),
                 0 1.4cqw 3cqw -1cqw rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 -.8cqw 1.6cqw rgba(0,40,60,.16)}
}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb:hover, #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb:focus-visible{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06); outline:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb:focus-visible::after{border-color:var(--c1-lit, #3DE0F5); inset:-1cqw; border-width:.3cqw}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sel::after{border-color:var(--c1); inset:-1cqw; border-width:.32cqw}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sel{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.07)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb[data-status="bad"]::after{border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 80%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb[data-status="good"]::after{border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 75%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.dup::after{border-style:dashed}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb-in{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.35cqw; width:82%}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-l{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:max(9px,1.05cqw); letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--orb-ink-2); line-height:1.15;
  white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; max-width:100%}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-v{font-size:max(15px,2.7cqw); line-height:1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-v .val .u{color:var(--orb-ink-2)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-v .skel-line{background:rgba(0,40,60,.12)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pips{display:flex; gap:.55cqw; margin-top:.25cqw}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pip{width:max(6px,.75cqw); height:max(6px,.75cqw); border-radius:50%; background:#9AABB8;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.good{background:#1B9A62} #cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.bad{background:#D93544} #cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.flat{background:#8697A5}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.none{background:transparent; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #9AABB8}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.wait{background:#C8D3DB; animation:ceo-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ceo-pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .o-cap{position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 1.3cqw); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
  white-space:nowrap; font-size:max(10px,1.15cqw); color:var(--ink-2); pointer-events:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.dup .o-cap{color:var(--ink-3); font-style:italic}

#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre{cursor:default; animation:none; color:var(--orb-ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6), 0 0 5cqw 1.4cqw var(--orb-halo),
             0 2cqw 5cqw -1.5cqw rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 -1.4cqw 2.8cqw rgba(0,40,60,.18)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre::after{inset:-1.2cqw; border-color:var(--ring-faint)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .gauge{position:absolute; inset:5%; width:90%; height:90%; overflow:visible}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .gauge .g-track{fill:none; stroke:rgba(0,40,60,.12); stroke-width:3; stroke-linecap:round}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .gauge .g-val{fill:none; stroke:#008C9E; stroke-width:3; stroke-linecap:round;
  transition:d .6s var(--ease-out)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .gauge .g-val.bad{stroke:#D93544} #cmd-wrap.ceo .gauge .g-val.good{stroke:#1B9A62}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .orb-in{width:70%; gap:.6cqw}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .o-l{font-size:max(9px,1.05cqw); white-space:normal; line-height:1.3}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .o-v{font-size:max(26px,5.2cqw)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .o-s{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.6cqw; font-size:max(10px,1.1cqw); color:var(--orb-ink-2);
  flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .o-r{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:max(8.5px,.9cqw); letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--orb-ink-2)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .dl.good{background:rgba(27,154,98,.14); color:#157A4E}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .dl.bad{background:rgba(217,53,68,.13); color:#B32434}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .dl.flat, #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .dl.neutral{background:rgba(0,40,60,.08); color:#4A5A6A}

@container (max-width:680px){
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit-bg{display:none}
}

/* ── pulse ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pulse{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr{display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,1.05fr) repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:8px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.ph .pc{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.ph .pc .ic{color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.pn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; text-align:left; border:0; cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--ink-1); padding:14px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-2);
  border:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.ph .pc.pn{background:none; border:0; cursor:default; padding:0 14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pn-t{display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pn-l{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:15px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pn-s{font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-3); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .st{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; background:var(--ink-4)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .st-good{background:var(--good); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--ok-wash)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .st-bad{background:var(--bad); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--crit-wash)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .st-mixed{background:var(--warn); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--warn-wash)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .st-wait{background:var(--ink-4); animation:ceo-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.cell{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; grid-template-rows:auto auto;
  column-gap:12px; row-gap:6px; align-items:end; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;
  padding:12px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--edge);
  color:var(--ink-1); min-width:0; transition:border-color .15s, background .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.cell:hover{border-color:var(--edge-lit); background:var(--surface-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.cell:disabled{cursor:default; opacity:.6}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-n{grid-column:1 / -1; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-2); line-height:1.35;
  display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:1; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-v{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-v .val{font-size:22px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-sp{width:96px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-sp .spark{width:96px; height:26px; display:block}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cl-why{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--ink-3); max-width:150px; line-height:1.3}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.sel .pc{border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c1) 55%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.dup .pc.cell{opacity:.72}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .muted{color:var(--ink-3)}

/* ── portfolio tabs and body ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ptabs{display:flex; gap:6px; overflow-x:auto; padding-bottom:6px; margin-bottom:16px;
  scrollbar-width:thin}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ptab{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; text-align:left; padding:10px 14px;
  border-radius:11px; border:1px solid var(--edge); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-2);
  cursor:pointer; flex:none; transition:border-color .15s, background .15s, color .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ptab:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-lit)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ptab[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--c1);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c1) 10%, var(--surface-2))}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pt-t{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pt-l{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:13.5px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pt-s{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--ink-3); max-width:180px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pb-h{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pb-t{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:24px; letter-spacing:-.025em}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pb-s{display:flex; gap:7px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pb-a{display:flex; gap:8px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pbody .note{margin:0 0 12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc{padding:16px 16px 12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:228px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc.flash{animation:ceo-flash 1.6s var(--ease-out)}
@keyframes ceo-flash{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--c1), 0 0 30px var(--c1)}100%{}}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-e{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px;
  letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-e .ic{width:13px; height:13px; color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-n{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.38; color:var(--ink-1);
  margin:8px 0 10px; min-height:36px; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2;
  -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-v{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-v .val.big{font-size:34px; line-height:1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-s{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; margin-top:8px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-s.why{color:var(--ink-3); font-style:italic; line-height:1.4}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pa{display:flex; gap:7px; align-items:baseline}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pa-k{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .pa-v{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-2); font-size:12.5px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .now{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-sp{margin-top:auto; padding-top:12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-sp .spark{width:100%; height:34px; display:block}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-sl{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.08em; color:var(--ink-4); margin-top:3px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-m, #cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-f{margin-top:8px; font-size:11px; color:var(--warn)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-a{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:10px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-a:empty{display:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .kc.off .kc-v .val{opacity:.6}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .lnk{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500;
  color:var(--c1)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .lnk .ic{width:13px; height:13px; transition:transform .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .lnk:hover .ic{transform:translateX(2px)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .lnk.q{color:var(--ink-2)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bdwrap{margin-top:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .bdwrap .panel.bd{cursor:pointer}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .cp-f{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; align-items:center; margin-top:10px;
  padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}

/* ── info popover ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ipop{display:none; position:absolute; z-index:60; padding:14px 16px 16px; border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--edge-2);
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ipop.on{display:block}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ip-h{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:8px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ip-dl{display:grid; grid-template-columns:96px 1fr; gap:7px 12px; margin:0; font-size:12px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ip-dl dt{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); padding-top:2px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ip-dl dd{margin:0; color:var(--ink-1); line-height:1.45}

/* ── trust ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .trust{display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr); gap:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tv-r{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:4px 12px; align-items:center;
  padding:10px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tv-t{font-size:13px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tv-n{grid-column:1 / -1; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-3)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tn{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:14px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .tnote .sm{margin:0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-foot{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:44px;
  padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-3)}

/* ── the drawer ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .drawer{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:80; pointer-events:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-shade{position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(3,6,10,.5); opacity:0; transition:opacity .25s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-p{position:absolute; top:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:min(420px,92vw); display:flex;
  flex-direction:column; background:var(--surface); border-left:1px solid var(--edge-2);
  box-shadow:-30px 0 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7); transform:translateX(102%);
  transition:transform .32s var(--ease-out)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .drawer.open{pointer-events:auto}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .drawer.open .dr-shade{opacity:1}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .drawer.open .dr-p{transform:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-h{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:20px 20px 14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-h .sm{margin:4px 0 0}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-b{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:8px 20px 20px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-g{padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-gl{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-3); margin-bottom:10px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .opts{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .opt{font-size:12px; padding:6px 11px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--edge-2);
  background:transparent; color:var(--ink-2); cursor:pointer; transition:all .15s}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .opt:hover{color:var(--ink-1); border-color:var(--edge-lit)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .opt.on{border-color:var(--c1); color:var(--ink-1);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c1) 16%, transparent)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-f{display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; padding:14px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--edge)}

/* ── toast, closed page ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo .toast{position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:26px; transform:translate(-50%,20px); opacity:0; z-index:90;
  padding:10px 16px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--ink-1); color:var(--void); font-size:12.5px;
  transition:opacity .2s, transform .2s; pointer-events:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .toast.on{opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-closed{min-height:70vh; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:40px 20px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-closed .panel{max-width:560px}
#cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-closed .btn{margin-top:14px}

/* busy: values being recounted stay visible but say so */
#cmd-wrap.ceo.busy .kgrid, #cmd-wrap.ceo.busy .pulse{opacity:.72; transition:opacity .2s}

/* ── presenting: a wall display ── */
#cmd-wrap.ceo.presenting .bar-r > :not(.seg):not(.asof):not(.ibtn[aria-label^="Present"]){display:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo.presenting .fchips{display:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo.presenting .ceo-page{max-width:none}
#cmd-wrap.ceo.presenting .kc-a, #cmd-wrap.ceo.presenting .ibtn.sm{display:none}

/* ── responsive ── */
@media (max-width:1180px){
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .hero-l{order:2}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .kgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav{display:none}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .trust, #cmd-wrap.ceo .tn{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-page{padding:0 16px 40px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-bar{margin:0 -16px; padding-left:16px; padding-right:16px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .pr{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .pr.ph{display:none}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .kgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .asof{display:none}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit{aspect-ratio:auto; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:44px 18px;
    padding:10px 0 34px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .orb{position:relative; left:auto !important; top:auto !important; transform:none;
    width:auto !important; max-width:170px; justify-self:center}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .orb.centre{grid-column:1 / -1; max-width:260px; width:100% !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb:hover, #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sel{transform:scale(1.03)}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-v{font-size:22px} #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.centre .o-v{font-size:38px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb .o-l{font-size:9.5px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .o-cap{font-size:11px; top:calc(100% + 8px)}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring.flow, #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb.sat, #cmd-wrap.ceo .pip.wait, #cmd-wrap.ceo .st-wait, #cmd-wrap.ceo .skel-line::after{animation:none}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb, #cmd-wrap.ceo .dr-p, #cmd-wrap.ceo .toast{transition:none}
}

/* ── print: the PDF export ── */
@media print{
  #cmd-wrap.ceo{background:#fff !important; color:#111}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-bar .bar-r, #cmd-wrap.ceo .bar-nav, #cmd-wrap.ceo .drawer, #cmd-wrap.ceo .toast,
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .ipop, #cmd-wrap.ceo .kc-a, #cmd-wrap.ceo .ibtn, #cmd-wrap.ceo .ptabs,
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .cp-f .lnk{display:none !important}
  /* The platform's own print sheet hides buttons and prints every link's URL after
     it. The orbs are buttons, and a query string is not something to read on paper. */
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb{display:grid !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #999 !important; animation:none !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.cell, #cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.pn, #cmd-wrap.ceo .mv{display:grid !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .pc.pn, #cmd-wrap.ceo .mv{display:flex !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo a[href]:after, #cmd-wrap.ceo a:after{content:none !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orb, #cmd-wrap.ceo .mv, #cmd-wrap.ceo .pc, #cmd-wrap.ceo .ptab,
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .opt{visibility:visible !important}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .ceo-bar{position:static; background:#fff; backdrop-filter:none; border-bottom:1px solid #ccc}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit .ring.flow{animation:none}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .sec{padding-top:18px}
  #cmd-wrap.ceo .orbit, #cmd-wrap.ceo .kc, #cmd-wrap.ceo .pr, #cmd-wrap.ceo .panel{break-inside:avoid; page-break-inside:avoid}
}

</style>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="DELETE"><active>true</active><description>COMMAND dashboards client asset. content hash 80b87d73</description><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_2185255_command.cmd_render_80b87d73</name><script><![CDATA[/**
 * cmd_render. The client renderer for the COMMAND dashboards.
 *
 * Reads the payload the server embedded in the page and builds the DOM. There is
 * no charting library: every mark is SVG generated here.
 *
 * That is a deliberate decision and it is worth stating, because reaching for
 * ECharts would be the obvious move. Three reasons not to:
 *
 *   1. Licensing. The client's first and most emphatic concern was third-party
 *      components deployed inside their instance. No library means nothing to
 *      disclose, no Apache-2.0 notice obligation, and no OEM question if this ever
 *      ships through the Store.
 *   2. Payload. The chart engine is the biggest single lever on a 250 KB budget,
 *      and a custom build of a general-purpose library still carries the
 *      abstractions needed to be general purpose.
 *   3. Fidelity. The approved brand kit specifies 25 chart forms as hand-authored
 *      SVG with particular mark geometry: 4px rounded data-ends anchored to the
 *      baseline, a 2px surface gap between adjacent fills, selective direct
 *      labels. Reproducing that through a library's theming layer is more work
 *      than drawing it.
 *
 * The cost is that each form is implemented by hand, so the FORMS table below is
 * the honest list of what renders. Anything the engine can emit that is not in
 * that table falls back to a labelled table view rather than a blank panel, which
 * is also the accessibility fallback every chart needs anyway.
 *
 * ES5. No build step, no transpiler, loaded by src from a UI Script.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

  /* Categorical order is fixed and never cycled. These are the validated light
     theme steps from the brand kit: OKLab lightness band, chroma floor, CVD
     separation against the white chart surface. A ninth series is never a
     generated hue, it folds into Other. */
  var CAT = ['--c1', '--c2', '--c3', '--c4', '--c5', '--c6'];
  var OTHER = '--c-other';
  var SEQ = ['--q1', '--q2', '--q3', '--q4', '--q5', '--q6', '--q7'];

  // ── small helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }

  function svgEl(tag, attrs) {
    var n = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    if (attrs) {
      for (var k in attrs) {
        if (attrs.hasOwnProperty(k) && attrs[k] !== null && attrs[k] !== undefined) {
          n.setAttribute(k, String(attrs[k]));
        }
      }
    }
    return n;
  }

  function svgRoot(w, h) {
    var s = svgEl('svg', {
      viewBox: '0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h,
      'class': 'ch',
      preserveAspectRatio: 'xMidYMid meet',
      role: 'img'
    });
    return s;
  }

  function v(token) { return 'var(' + token + ')'; }

  /* The scope prefix of the page we are on, and every COMMAND link rewritten to
     carry it. A scoped UI Page is served at <scope>_<name>.do, so a relative
     `cmd_dashboard.do` from the scoped catalog resolved to the GLOBAL fallback
     page -- the same product, a different deployment, and a quiet way for a
     demo of the delivered scoped app to be running the fallback instead. */
  var PFX = (function () {
    var m = /\/(x_[a-z0-9_]+?_)cmd_(?:dashboard|catalog|ceo)\.do/.exec((window.location && window.location.pathname) || '');
    return m ? m[1] : '';
  })();

  function P(u) {
    return String(u || '').replace(/(^|\/)(cmd_(?:dashboard|catalog|ceo)\.do)/, function (m0, lead, name) {
      return lead + PFX + name;
    });
  }

  function catColour(i) { return i < CAT.length ? v(CAT[i]) : v(OTHER); }

  function fmt(n) {
    if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return '0';
    var neg = n < 0;
    var s = String(Math.round(Math.abs(n)));
    var out = '', c = 0;
    for (var i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      out = s.charAt(i) + out;
      if (++c % 3 === 0 && i > 0) out = ',' + out;
    }
    return (neg ? '-' : '') + out;
  }

  /* "1 records" appeared in the page subheader, in every chart tooltip, and in the
     reason text on every rejected drill level, because the count and the noun were
     concatenated at twenty-one separate sites. Small, but it is the kind of thing a
     client reads as carelessness in everything else on the page. */
  function recs(n) {
    return fmt(n) + (Math.round(Math.abs(n)) === 1 ? ' record' : ' records');
  }

  function compact(n) {
    var a = Math.abs(n);
    if (a >= 1e9) return (n / 1e9).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'b';
    if (a >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'm';
    if (a >= 10000) return Math.round(n / 1000) + 'k';
    return fmt(n);
  }

  function pct(x, digits) {
    var p = x * 100;
    if (digits === undefined) digits = (p < 10 && p > 0) ? 1 : 0;
    return p.toFixed(digits) + '%';
  }

  function label(row) {
    if (row.label !== undefined && row.label !== null && row.label !== '') return row.label;
    if (row.key === '' || row.key === null) return '(none)';
    return String(row.key);
  }

  function truncate(s, n) {
    /* Collapse whitespace first. Values coming off the instance can carry
       newlines and tabs, and a label with a line break in it breaks a legend
       row's layout with no obvious cause. */
    s = String(s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/^ | $/g, '');
    return s.length > n ? s.substring(0, n - 1) + '…' : s;
  }
